subject: Genetics
title: The Genetics of Height
description: A quick win: understand The Genetics of Height.

hook.text: Height isn't one gene. It's over 700 genes working together, plus nutrition, sleep, and childhood health.

buildup.text: Each height gene contributes a tiny effect—maybe a millimeter. Together they create the wide range of human heights.

discovery.text: Height is about 80% genetic and 20% environmental. Genes set the range; nutrition determines where you land in it.

twist.text: Average height increased 10 cm over the 20th century—mostly nutrition, not genetics. Genes didn't change. Diets did.

climax.text: Polygenic traits form bell curves. Most people are average. Extremes on both ends are rare.

punchline.text: 700 genes and a good breakfast. That decides your height.

quiz.question: About how many genes influence human height?
